senses.gloss: m. (אַרְבֵּל I) a native or resident of Arbel, Arbelite.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 19">Gen. R. s. 19</cite>, beg.; cmp.

<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 1:18">Koh. R. to I, 18</cite>.—[<cite ref="Tosefta Parah 12:16">Tosef. Par. XII</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Parah 11:16">XI</cite>), 16 <he>כוש הא׳</he>, v. next w.]—Fem. <cite ref="A02964"><he>אַרְבֵּלִית</he></cite>.

Y. Peah VII, 20ᵃ bot.; Y. Sot. I, 17ᵇ; IX, 24ᵇ bot. סאה א׳ one S’ah of Arbelite wheat. [Ib. IV, end, 19ᵈ top רבי מר עוקבא הורה בארבלי Arbeli, supposed to be a place in Babylon. The entire sentence is spurious both from Mar Ukba’s title of Rabbi as well as from comparison with Keth. 60ᵇ.]
